name: Ceriale (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ceriale (a Roman soldier above a wheat sheaf) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Ceriale, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Ceriale arms — Roman soldier above a wheat sheaf, crowned, within branches
